title: Open Values Tag Registry v0.1
description: The list of labels an option can carry, such as Organic or Fair Trade, with the other spellings that count as the same label and a sentence on what each one means. Conscious Consuming keeps it.

format.description: Always "ovs-tag-registry". Tells a reader that this file is the list of labels entries can carry.

version.description: The version of the tag registry format this file follows, 0.1.

updated.description: The day the file was last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

minItems.description: The fewest entries a tag must be found on before it gets its own page and appears in search. The current file uses 10.

tags.description: The tags: labels such as "Organic" or "Fair Trade" that entries carry in their focuses.

id.description: The tag's id, written "ovs:tag/" then a short name, such as "ovs:tag/fair-trade".

label.description: The tag's name as shown to people, such as "Fair Trade".

aliases.description: Other spellings of the label found in the data, such as "fairtrade". An entry carrying any of them, or the label itself, counts as carrying the tag.

kind.description: What sort of tag it is: "property" for a fact about the item such as vegan, "certification" for a third-party certification such as Fair Trade, or "topic" for a subject.

reads.description: One sentence saying what the tag means and how far a reader can rely on it.

receipt.description: A web address that defines the tag, such as the certifier's own page, or null where there is none.
